common: The goblin is killed — no blush, no smile. The dagger keeps exactly the same size and shape. Everything stays inside the canvas.

d1.hands: The dagger stays in the SAME hand as in base.png — the NEAR hand (arm on the RIGHT side of the figure) — until the frame where it is written that it slips out. The other hand stays empty. The dagger arm follows the body's motion with a slight lag, and the wrist is dragged so the blade trails behind the hand (never stiffly pointing forward).
